chunks: Have they settled upon a plan? We shall also settle on one.

key_terms.أَبْرَمُوا: They settled upon or finalized a plan
key_terms.مُبْرِمُونَ: We are decisive and effective in our plan

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean when it says 'We shall also settle on a plan'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine counter-action to the Quraysh's political and military machinations, affirming that God's 'plotting' (ibrām) is not merely reactive but supremely decisive and inevitable. It serves as a reassurance to the believers that despite the apparent strength of their enemies' strategies, God's ultimate plan ensures their defeat, a theme often linked to the concept of divine sovereignty over human affairs.
